items.title: investingLive Americas FX news wrap 11 Aug: Stocks /yields Slip as markets await US CPI
items.summary: U.S. markets are wrapping up Tuesday with stocks mostly lower, Treasury yields modestly lower across most of the curve, and the U.S. dollar little changed against the major currencies.
items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.
items.summaryZh: 美国股市周二收盘，股价主要走低，大部分曲线上的国债收益率略有下降，美元兑主要货币几乎没有变化。
items.summaryEn: U.S. markets are wrapping up Tuesday with stocks mostly lower, Treasury yields modestly lower across most of the curve, and the U.S. dollar little changed against the major currencies.
